title: 100 Euro Wildlife Gold Coin Set
descriptionPlain: Complete set: 100-euro gold coin series “Wildlife” – all 6 gold coins together in an elegant wooden boxWild about gold?With the exclusive complete set of the 6-piece gold coin series “Wildlife,” you can secure an extraordinary collector's item that impressively honors the diversity of native species. Each coin in this series depicts a wild animal together with its characteristic habitat – masterfully designed, richly detailed and an expression of the highest art of engraving. In total, you will receive 3 ounces of fine gold (approx. 96 grams), distributed across all six motifs:• Wild boar• Capercaillie• Red deer• Fox• Ibex• MallardThese impressive depictions make each coin a work of art in its own right – and the entire set a golden trophy for any discerning collection.Elegant wooden box with artistic metal appliquéThese wild animals not only cut an impressive figure in the forest. The coins are also perfectly showcased in the high-quality, solid collector's box made of fine wood.The center of the lid features an intricately designed metal appliqué, created by the mint's experienced engravers and manufactured in-house. This detail lends the case a special value and makes it a decorative eye-catcher that stylishly complements the beauty of the animal motifs.Wild animals in their most beautiful form – artfully immortalized in pure gold and stylishly presented in a high-quality box.
